title: Exhaust — Thrust Reverser Self-Lubricating Link Bushing and Two-Lip Aft Seal Installation
abstract: Installation of the self-lubricating blocker door link bushing and the two-lip aft seal on the translating sleeve, removing the debris path that drives link wear on high-cycle engines.

sections.planning_reason: Blocker door link bushings were found worn oval on the loaded flank at between four and six thousand cycles against a design life of twenty thousand, producing deployment times that drift apart between the two halves of a cowl. Two events produced a partially stowed blocker with the sleeve fully stowed, which the position sensing does not detect and which was found on a scheduled inspection rather than in service. The wear was traced to the aft seal admitting fan-stream debris into the link housing.
sections.description: The link bushing is replaced by a self-lubricating item and its housing is reamed to suit. The aft seal is replaced by a two-lip item that runs on a machined land rather than on the sleeve skin, the nozzle kit is re-drilled at the seal retainer and countersunk washers are used at every retainer fastener. The clevis pin at the link is replaced with a corrosion-resistant item of the same size and a new retention.
sections.accomplishment_summary: This Service Bulletin is accomplished with the reverser halves off the engine, at overhaul. Do AMM-S-78-30-11-000-047-A to remove the blocker door links. Ream each link housing to the dimension in the accomplishment instructions and install the self-lubricating bushing. Machine the seal land on the translating sleeve and re-drill the nozzle kit D7830110928662 at the seal retainer. Install the two-lip seal D7830117902757 and secure the retainer with the countersunk washers AGS5451K6 at every position. Install the clevis pins EN768314K5 with the new retention. Renew the seal 6577ET and the nozzle 9ET, and inspect the mount link 83ET before refitting it. Do AMM-S-78-30-11-400-047-A to install the blocker door links. CAUTION: BOTH HALVES OF ONE ENGINE MUST BE BROUGHT TO THE SAME STANDARD IN THE SAME SHOP VISIT. Do the reverser rigging and the deployment test, and record the deployment time of each half.
sections.effectivity_note: Applicable to SOLANO-30 and SOLANO-34 aircraft with Auran 7720 or CVX-6080 engines that are not already at the self-lubricating bushing standard. Aircraft from MSN S01466 onward are post-modification from build. The wear inspection bulletin must have been accomplished at least once before embodiment, so that the as-found housing condition is on record.
sections.material_note: Kit K7830-1008-01 covers one reverser half and contains four bushings, the two-lip seal, the retainer washer set and the clevis pin set. Four kits are needed per aircraft. Lead time is twenty-four weeks; the self-lubricating bushing is the long-lead item. Removed bushings are returned for wear analysis.

type_data.compliance_time: At the next reverser overhaul, or within 60 months after the date of this Service Bulletin, whichever occurs first.
